effect_description_eng:
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Opponent's Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, by suspending this Tamer, change the attack target to 1 of your Digimon with the [Unidentified] or [CS] trait.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, if this Digimon is [Eater Adam], you may change the attack target to 1 of your [Unidentified] or [CS] trait Digimon.
